text: みずに　はいる　まえの　じゅんび　たいそう！
note: じゅんびたいそう is the set of warm-up exercises Japanese children are made to do at school before every swimming lesson, so the phrase has a school-pool ring to it.
claim: In Japanese schools, pupils do warm-up exercises (junbi taisō) before swimming lessons.

check.quote: 一般に準備運動をして体温を上げ、シャワーを浴びて汗を流してからプールに入ります。
